content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: This recruitment is for Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse posts at the maternity and newborn care centres of the Government Medical College Hospital and government hospitals in Dharmapuri district, filled through the District Health Society. The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Nursing diploma (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a government or government-recognised college
Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration compulsory; Tamil studied as a language subject
Offline: filled-in form submitted to the office

content_sections.heading: About Dharmapuri District Health Society
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Dharmapuri is the district health body whose notice is signed by the Secretary (District Health Officer) and the Chairman (District Collector), Dharmapuri. The notice is issued for posts in the Government Medical College Hospital and government hospitals in Dharmapuri district.

content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications are open as of 21 November 2026. The notice states that applications not submitted within the stated time will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 57 vacancies for one post. The notice says the number of vacancies is subject to change. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have studied Tamil as a language subject. A copy of the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate is among the documents to be attached. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: Nursing diploma (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing, completed in a government or government-recognised college. Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is within 50 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Salary 2026
Contract Terms
content_sections.text: The posts are entirely temporary, on an 11-month contract through the District Health Society. Selected candidates are to be appointed as per G.O. No. 427, Health and Family Welfare Department, dated 18.11.2026. Candidates have no right to claim a job.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the district website, www.dharamapuri.nic.in . Fill in the application form. Attach copies of the supporting documents listed below. Submit the application to the District Health Society / Town Health Society office: District Health Officer, District Health Office, Dharmapuri. Submit it by 5 PM on 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Class 10 educational certificate Copy of Class 12 educational certificate Nursing qualification certificate and mark lists Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate Residence proof: nativity certificate issued by the Revenue Department, or voter ID / Aadhaar card / family card Community certificate Copy of the differently-abled / transgender / destitute widow certificate, as applicable

content_sections.heading: Dharmapuri District Health Society Staff Nurse Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The vacancy number is subject to change. Applications not submitted within the stated time will not be accepted. The posts are temporary and carry no right to claim a job.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there at Dharmapuri District Health Society?
faq.answer: There are 57 Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse vacancies, and the number is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by 5 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: A nursing diploma (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a government or government-recognised college, with Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration. Tamil must also have been studied as a language subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is within 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 21000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How and where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.dharamapuri.nic.in, fill it in, attach document copies and submit it to the District Health Officer, District Health Office, Dharmapuri, by 5 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are entirely temporary, on an 11-month contract, and the notice says candidates have no right to claim a job.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Class 10 and Class 12 certificates, nursing qualification certificate and mark lists, Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration certificate, residence proof, community certificate and, as applicable, the differently-abled / transgender / destitute widow certificate.
